records.jp: 未知の島、ね……
records.en_original: A strange island...
records.en: An unknown island, huh...

records.jp: ココロトープとは違うの？
records.en_original: Is it different from the Heartscapes?
records.en: Is it different from the Heartscapes?

records.jp: どうだろう……。<CR>それなら今までと同じ手段で行けるはずだけど……
records.en_original: I wonder... If it was, it should have appeared the same way as the others.
records.en: I wonder...<CR>If it were a Heartscape, we should be able to reach it the usual way...

records.jp: ま、実際のところは行ってみないと分からないね
records.en_original: Either way, we won't know until we go.
records.en: Either way, we won't know until we go.

records.jp: ちょっと待ったーーーーーっ！！
records.en_original: Stop right there!
records.en: Waaait!!

records.jp: 話は聞かせてもらった
records.en_original: We heard what you're up to.
records.en: We heard everything.

records.jp: 何やら楽しそうなことを計画している様子……
records.en_original: You're all doing something fun without us.
records.en: Sounds like you're planning something fun...

records.jp: 未知の島……あたしたちも連れて行けーーーい！！
records.en_original: Take us with you to this mysterious island!
records.en: An unknown island... Take us with yooou!!

records.jp: 行けーーい
records.en_original: Take us with you!
records.en: Take us with yooou!

records.jp: ●カット
私たちは止めたんですよ
records.en_original: We tried to stop them.
records.en: We tried to stop them.

records.jp: でも、二人が聞かなくて
records.en_original: They just wouldn't listen.
records.en: They just wouldn't listen.

records.jp: 気分は大航海時代のコロンブス。<CR>未知の冒険がきららたちを待っている
records.en_original: It's a new age of exploration and we're Columbus. It's time for adventure.
records.en: Kirara feels like Columbus in the Age of Exploration.<CR>An unknown adventure awaits Kirara and the others.

records.jp: 新しい島を探検なんて……<CR>みんなで行った方が絶対楽しいじゃん！
records.en_original: An island adventure... It would be so much more fun with everyone together!
records.en: Exploring a new island...<CR>It'll definitely be more fun if we all go together!

records.jp: 気分転換……
records.en_original: A change of pace...
records.en: A change of pace...

records.jp: そう！　そういうこと！
records.en_original: Yeah, exactly!
records.en: Yeah, exactly!

records.jp: 何があるか分からないし、危ないと思うんだけど……
records.en_original: We don't know what is waiting for us there, it could be dangerous.
records.en: We don't know what's there. It could be dangerous...

records.jp: でもでも、わたしたちだいぶ強くなったよ？
records.en_original: But we've gotten quite strong, don't you think?
records.en: But we've gotten quite strong, don't you think?

records.jp: ……まあねぇ
records.en_original: I suppose...
records.en: I suppose...

records.jp: 少なくともモンスター相手なら大丈夫だと思うよ<CR>
records.en_original: If all we're dealing with is demons, then we should be fine.
records.en: At least if all we're facing is monsters, we should be fine.<CR>

records.jp: もし本当に危険ならすぐに帰ればいいですからね
records.en_original: And if it really does turn out to be dangerous, we can leave right away.
records.en: And if it really does turn out to be dangerous, we can leave right away.

records.jp: んーーー、なら、まあ……いいか
records.en_original: Mmm... Well, fine then.
records.en: Mmm... Well, fine then.

records.jp: おしゃーーーー！
records.en_original: Yesss!
records.en: Yesss!

records.jp: 迷惑かけるわね
records.en_original: I hope we won't be too much trouble.
records.en: Sorry for the trouble.

records.jp: そんなことないよ！<CR>私もお姉ちゃんと一緒に行けて嬉しいし
records.en_original: Don't worry so much! I'm glad we get to do this with you!
records.en: Not at all!<CR>I'm happy I get to go with you too, Onee-chan.

records.jp: 大所帯だね！
records.en_original: We're like a big family!
records.en: We've got quite a crowd!

records.jp: だいぶ増えたよね……
records.en_original: There are quite a few of us now...
records.en: There are quite a few of us now...

records.jp: そうと決まったら……<CR>行くぞ！　船に乗り込めーー！！
records.en_original: Now that it's been decided... It's time to set sail! Squeeze in, everyone!
records.en: Now that that's settled...<CR>All aboard the boat!!

records.jp: おー！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: ●カット
●カット
●カット
